In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Shogar Tok]] established a '''fortress''' for himself on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]], home to the planet's formidable [[magna-gun]]s. It was [[Battle of Brentaal IV (Clone Wars)|attacked]] by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces in 22 BBY.
